coder_notes: Supportive-care trial: topical clindamycin + triamcinolone to prevent TTFields skin toxicity; no antitumour hypothesis or outcome. TTFields is a device, not listed. Exclusion criteria list 'Malignant glioma', which appears contradictory (likely meaning non-GBM malignant glioma); arm label says newly diagnosed GBM while inclusion allows newly diagnosed or recurrent. Moiety mapped from salt/ester (clindamycin phosphate, triamcinolone acetonide) to parent.
